record.what_it_does: A white-label payment gateway (an NMI-powered reseller/ISO brand) that lets a merchant or platform process card payments, manage customers/recurring billing, run reports, and board merchants via NMI's real-time v4 REST API.
record.auth_notes: No distinct public developer site for 'Paygent Connect' itself was found; it appears to be a reseller/white-label instance of the NMI payment gateway, so this research documents the underlying NMI v4 API that such branded products are built on. Authentication is a 'Security Key' (v4 API permission) generated in the Partner Portal and sent in the Authorization header — not an OAuth2 flow.
record.access_notes: NMI provides a free self-serve sandbox ('Pathfinder') — sign up with email/company name at nmi.com → Developers → Explore Sandbox and immediately receive sandbox API keys/test portals, no cost. However, NMI does not sell merchant accounts directly to end users; production/live credentials are issued only through a reseller, ISO, or payment-facilitator partner relationship, so real production access is effectively partner-gated even though sandbox testing is self-serve.
record.main_blocker: Production credentials require going through an NMI reseller/ISO/payfac partnership, not direct self-serve signup; also no distinct 'Paygent Connect' brand with its own public docs was found

evidence.quote: Create a new key for your username with "v4 API" permissions. This key will be used in the header to authenticate all requests.
Pathfinder is our free sandbox environment. It allows you to explore our platform, test payment flows, and integrate with our APIs
The payment gateway's real-time v4 API is a complete API that allows you to build any payment features found in your NMI Partner Portal.
NMI Developer Portal hosts a remote MCP server at `https://docs.nmi.com/mcp`. Configure your AI development tools to connect to this server.
Each endpoint can be subscribed to specific events that happen in the gateway. Most events have multiple versions: success, failure, and unknown.

record.open_questions: Could not find any distinct public company/product page for 'Paygent Connect' itself (searches only surfaced an unrelated Japanese payment provider called 'Paygent' with its own non-NMI API, and unrelated AI-agent-billing/crypto-wallet startups also named 'Paygent'). Given the hint '(NMI-powered)', this report treats it as a white-label brand built on NMI's gateway, but the specific reseller's own branding, pricing, or any customizations could not be verified. Also could not confirm whether NMI publishes a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file (its docs.nmi.com reference pages are ReadMe.io-hosted but no public spec file was located).
